# Metal Werx Scrap Metal Recycling

> Scrap metal recycling yard at 131 Wedgewood Rd, Hallam VIC 3803, in Melbourne's south-east, run by Metal Werx Pty Ltd (ABN 19 650 365 067).
> Buys ferrous and non-ferrous metals from homes, farms and businesses, and hires out bins and picks up scrap.
> Pays by bank transfer only, as Victorian law requires of scrap metal dealers, on the same day it buys the scrap; sellers need photo ID.
> Phone 0470 131 025, email info@metalwerx.com.au.

## Key pages

- [What we buy](https://metalwerx.com.au/what-we-buy): every material, with its grades and how to sell it
- [Scrap prices](https://metalwerx.com.au/prices): what the yard pays, by material
- [Bin hire](https://metalwerx.com.au/services/bin-hire): bins in different sizes, most often 1 m³ or 2.4 m³
- [Pickup and collection](https://metalwerx.com.au/services/pickup-and-collection)
- [Commercial recycling](https://metalwerx.com.au/services/commercial-recycling)
- [Areas we cover](https://metalwerx.com.au/areas): the south-east Melbourne suburbs the bins and pickups reach, each with its drive to the yard, and pages for ten of them
- [Contact and quotes](https://metalwerx.com.au/contact-us): phone, email, map and the quote form
- [About](https://metalwerx.com.au/about): who runs the yard, with its ABN and ACN

## Optional

- [Blog](https://metalwerx.com.au/blogs): tips on preparing and selling scrap
